name: AFM level 2 task 6: Scan-Time Effect On Contact-Mode Roughness
description: Acquire exactly three contact-mode topography images of the same 5 µm × 5 µm region using times per line of 0.1, 0.075, and 0.05 s, in that order. Keep the resolution at 256 × 256 pixels, normal-force setpoint at 10 nN, and P/I/D gains at 100/50/0. Before acquisition, calculate the nominal durations; the expected values are 25.6, 19.2, and 12.8 s, respectively, excluding overhead. Calculate rms and mean roughness for every image and report the percentage change of each metric relative to the 0.075 s-per-line result.
